sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 14599 of 2023
Petitioner :- Nitin And 3 Others

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sudhir Kumar Tiwari

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1. Heard Sri Sudhir Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri G.P. Singh, learned
A.G.A. for the State respondents.
2. The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First
Information Report dated 16.08.2023, registered as Case Crime No. 99 of 2023, under Sections
498A, 323, 504, 506 Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Raja Ka Rampur, District Etah and
for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First
Nitin And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 15 September, 2023
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189962298/

3. The submission is that all alleged offences are punishable with imprisonment upto seven years,
therefore the police authorities are bound to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C.
The petitioners have been wrongly implicated and could not be arrested.

Reliance has been placed on the judgement of Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar, (2014) 8 SCC 273 and Social Action Forum for Manav Adhikar Vs. Union of India, Ministry of Law and Justice and others in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 73 of 2015 with Criminal Appeal No. 1265 of 2017, Writ Petition (Criminal) No. 156 of 2017, Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another,
(2022) 10 SCC 51 and co-ordinate Division Bench of this Court in Vimal Kumar & 3 others Vs. State of U.P. & 3 others in 2021 (2) ACR 1147.
4.
